title: 第9章 官司要输第10章 最后一次警告
slug: 律师霸凌者无罪我送他死刑
content_zh:
林默淡笑道：“抱歉，要拿证据也不是给你看，你没有权利要求我拿证据。”
接著，林默扭头说道：“审判长，对方律师对我进行公开威胁，试图妨碍司法正常进程，我申请被告律师离位。”
我测！
黄轩被震身形都晃动了一下，死死的盯著林默
这傢伙有病啊！谁威胁你了！
这时候，王正华拿起法槌。
咚！
“申请无效，驳回，现在还未到被告律师发言，警告一次。”
黄轩嘴角疯狂抽出，尼玛上来就被警告了！
黄轩有些绷不住了。
我去你的！
我堂堂史丹福大学毕业的精英律师竟然被警告了！
还是被这种无名小卒无良律师整的。
黄轩感觉脸上无光。
立马安慰自己：
这林默是个低水平野路子，看来不了解法律，只能靠这种下三滥的手段干扰自己。
只要他拿不出来证据证明抢劫罪，那么他就会被拘留！
到时候自己直接就贏了，根本用不著为了这种人生气。
黄轩冷静了下来。
审判台上，王正华看著林默，严肃的警告道：

“诉讼方律师林默，如果你提交的诉讼申请，没有事实依据或者法律依据的话，也就是说，如果你作偽证，你將会被检方以偽证罪起诉，追究刑事责任，你確定？”
诉讼失败顶多是败诉，如果你要证明诉讼请求而作偽证，那就是刑事责任了！
顿时间，观看直播的人都留下了冷汗。
这林大律师，不会在抢劫罪上作偽证吧？
可林默很自信且肯定的说道：
“审判长，我都明白，我会对我所有的言论和提交的证据负责。”
哗啦。
法庭上现场观战的人都交流了起来。
林默如此自信，都在想林默能拿出什么抢劫罪相关的证据。
咚！
“肃静！”
王正华敲了敲法槌，继续说道：“接下来请被告方律师答辩和提交诉讼申请。”
黄轩冷笑了一下。
这种案子，简直就是手到擒来。
“我方答辩意见如下。”
“第一，针对诉讼方王大海一方对田英光等三位我当事人的控告，我全部驳回，並且要求严肃处理原告方律师这种漠视法律条文恶劣行径。”
“第二，由於原告污衊我方进行校园霸凌，且引起了社会舆论，对我方名誉造成了重大损失，我方要求60万元赔偿。”
content_en:
Lin Mo smiled lightly and said: "Sorry, I don't want to show you the evidence. You have no right to ask me to get evidence."
Then, Lin Mo turned around and said: "President, the other party's lawyer publicly threatened me and tried to obstruct the normal process of justice. I apply for the defendant's lawyer to leave."
I'll test it!
Huang Xuan was shaken and stared at Lin Mo.
This guy is sick! Who threatened you?
At this time, Wang Zhenghua picked up the gavel.
Boom!
"The application is invalid and rejected. It is not yet time for the defendant's lawyer to speak. I will give you a warning."
The corner of Huang Xuan's mouth twitched wildly, and he was warned when he came up!
Huang Xuan couldn't hold himself any longer.
Fuck you!
My elite lawyer who graduated from Stanford University was warned!
It was still done by this unknown and unscrupulous lawyer.
Huang Xuan felt dull on his face.
Immediately comfort yourself:
This Lin Mo is a low-level wild man. It seems that he doesn't understand the law and can only rely on such despicable methods to interfere with himself.
As long as he can't produce evidence to prove the crime of robbery, he will be detained!
When the time comes, you will win directly, and there is no need to be angry for this kind of person.
Huang Xuan calmed down.
On the trial stage, Wang Zhenghua looked at Lin Mo and warned seriously:
"Litigation lawyer Lin Mo, if the lawsuit application you submit has no factual or legal basis, that is to say, if you commit perjury, you will be prosecuted for perjury by the prosecutor and held criminally responsible. Are you sure?"
If the lawsuit fails, you will lose the case at best. If you commit perjury to prove the lawsuit, that will be criminal liability!
For a moment, everyone watching the live broadcast was sweating.
This lawyer Lin will not commit perjury on the crime of robbery, right?
But Lin Mo said confidently and definitely:
"President, I understand that I will be responsible for all my remarks and the evidence I submit."
Wow.
Everyone watching the battle in the court exchanged words.
Lin Mo was so confident that he was wondering what evidence Lin Mo could produce related to robbery.
Boom!
"Quiet!"
Wang Zhenghua knocked the gavel and continued: "Next, please ask the defendant's lawyer to respond and submit a lawsuit application."
Huang Xuan sneered.
This kind of case is simply easy to grasp.
"Our defense comments are as follows."
"First, I reject all the accusations made by Wang Dahai, the litigating party, against Tian Yingguang and three other clients of mine, and demand that the plaintiff's lawyer's heinous behavior of disregarding legal provisions be dealt with seriously."
"Second, because the plaintiff slandered us for campus bullying and aroused public opinion, causing heavy damage to our reputation, we demand 600,000 yuan in compensation."
